_comment: Decrease-only ledger for direction-authority/index.mjs. A file here still derives the reading direction by measuring the DOM instead of asking `useOptionalDirection`. `probes` is a COUNT PER FILE, not a line list: growth fails --check, a probe in an unpinned file fails as a new owner, and a shrink fails with an instruction to lower the pin, which is how the pin follows the tree DOWN. Anchor/portal readers are NOT pinned here -- they are declared in NAMED_EXCEPTIONS in the gate source, with the reason each one is a different read. Population measured 2026-09-17 after WO-INV-01 L1: the last fenced row, active-filters-bar (fenced while WO-FAM-08 stamped parts in that exact file; the fence lifted with 1416365a3/c94ec13f0), took its arrow-key model to the authority, so the ledger is EMPTY. It stays here rather than being deleted because the ratchet's job is now to keep it empty: the first file that re-derives direction from the DOM fails as an unpinned owner. The same lot widened the gate -- two more shapes (`document.dir` / `documentElement.dir`, and a DOM node's `.dir` compared to a direction literal) and the whole of `src` rather than `src/components`, so paths in this file and in NAMED_EXCEPTIONS are relative to `src`. That widening found ONE live site, `components/patterns/feedback/adaptive-overlay/index.tsx`, migrated in the same lot; every other hit outside `src/components` was a comment line describing the forbidden probe, and comment lines are not counted.
